title: 第7章 未婚妻，我不会御剑啊
slug: 绑定惹祸系统我被六个男主追杀
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

她早就说了，这系统像个废物。

这系统，也应该换她来当，连带宿主都带不明白。

而且系统一张口说话更是和反派没区别。

“系统，挑衅六个男主被追杀的任务我可以做，但我有个条件。”

昭杺柠知道甩不开系统，但也不想在往后的任务浪费时间跟系统吵。

【所以你的条件是什么？】

“我的条件是，任务我如何做，你都不许插手，你不用管过程和结果，你只看规则程序奖励判断就够了。”

“毕竟我任务的奖励，也不是你这个系统判定的，而是规则程序来判定。”

“连着两次规则程序都判定我任务完成，这就证明我做任务的方式是可行的。”昭杺柠道。

【只要你能完成挑衅男主们，并且被男主们追杀还成功逃生的任务，我可以不过多干涉你】

系统的回答，也像是被昭杺柠说服。

而昭杺柠，拿着钟离珟未婚妻的身份，也成功混入问天宗。

因为钟离珟的关系，所以昭杺柠的住所，也被安排在钟离珟所在的问剑峰。

“你们问天宗都是好奇宝宝吗？”钟离珟正准备御剑，就听见昭杺柠突然问道。

他回头疑惑：“什么意思？”

“又是问天，又是问剑，感觉你们问天宗对这个世界带有挺多疑惑的。”昭杺柠认真分析着。

听此，钟离珟嘴角微抽。

“小师婶，你算的真神啊。”一旁的问天宗弟子惊声夸赞。

“我们问天宗共有七峰，分别是问主峰，问剑峰，问药峰，问器峰等等以问开头。”

“而且我们问天宗的食堂，叫问膳堂。”

“这样算下来，我们问天宗的所有建筑，都是以问开头命名的诶。”问天宗弟子惊叹。

“你们有这么多问题好奇吗？”昭杺柠都惊了。

她没想到自己随口一说，还真说到了问天宗的精髓。

见昭杺柠对问天宗好奇，问天宗弟子一个个十分积极，围着昭杺柠就准备给她好好介绍。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

She has long said that this system is like crap.

She should be in charge of this system, even the host can't understand it.

Moreover, when the system speaks, it is no different from a villain.

"System, I can do the task of provoking the six male protagonists to be hunted down, but I have a condition."

Zhao Hao Ning knew that she couldn't get rid of the system, but she didn't want to waste time arguing with the system in future tasks.

[So what are your conditions?】

"My condition is that you are not allowed to interfere with how I do the tasks. You don't have to worry about the process and results. You only need to follow the rules, procedures and reward judgments."

"After all, the reward for my mission is not determined by your system, but by the rules and procedures."

"The rules and procedures have determined that my mission has been completed twice in a row, which proves that the way I do the mission is feasible." Zhao Huning said.

[As long as you can complete the task of provoking the male protagonists, and successfully escape from being chased by the male protagonists, I will not interfere with you too much]

The system's answer also seemed to be convinced by Zhao Hao Ning.

And Zhao Haining, using the identity of Zhongli Sui's fiancée, also successfully sneaked into Wentian Sect.

Because of Zhongli Sui's relationship, Zhao Hao Ning's residence was also arranged at Wenjian Peak where Zhongli Sui was located.

"Are you all curious babies asking about Tianzong?" Zhongli Sui was about to wield his sword when he heard Zhao Haining suddenly ask.

He turned around and wondered: "What do you mean?"

"Both Wentian and Wenjian, I feel that your Wentian Sect has a lot of doubts about this world." Zhao Huning analyzed carefully.

Hearing this, the corners of Zhongli Sui's mouth twitched slightly.

"Little Master Aunt, you are truly a god." The Wentian Sect disciples on the side praised in surprise.

"We Wentian Sect has seven peaks in total, namely Wenzhu Peak, Wenjian Peak, Wenyao Peak, Wenqi Peak, etc. The ones starting with Wen are Wen."

"And our Wentian Sect's canteen is called Wenshantang."

"After all, all the buildings in our Wentian Sect are named after Wen." A disciple of Wentian Sect exclaimed.

"Are you curious about so many questions?" Zhao Hao Ning was shocked.

She didn't expect that her casual remarks would actually touch upon the essence of Wentian Sect.

Seeing that Zhao Hao Ning was curious about Wentian Sect, the disciples of Wentian Sect were all very active and gathered around Zhao Hao Ning, preparing to give her a good introduction.
